'''Central Government Tower Number One''' was one of the three intricately carved red-orange government headquarter towers in the capital city of [[Calius saj Leeloo]]<ref name="TLC" /> on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Berchest system/Legends|Berchest system]]</ref> planet [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]] overlooking the [[Leefari Sea]].<ref name="TLC" />

While searching for the source of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] crossed paths with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]] at [[Mavrille Street]], not far from Central Government Tower Number One. Together they witnessed an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[cargo carrier]] which, with the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Luke sensed was carrying the clones. Unbeknownst to them, this was a ploy devised by Grand Admiral Thrawn, and Luke's appearance on Berchest was reported to Thrawn by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Raccyx Staffa]] and his aide, [[Fingal]].<ref name="TLC" />
